name: Crab Toe Touch
steps: Sit on the floor with knees bent, feet flat hip-width apart, and hands planted behind your hips.
Press through your palms and heels to lift your hips into a tabletop crab position.
Extend one leg upward while reaching your opposite hand across to tap that foot.
Return your hand and foot to the floor under control and alternate sides.
tips: Establish your balance on the supporting hand and foot before lifting the opposite limbs.
Keep your hips lifted and chest open instead of letting your supporting shoulder shrug.
